title: Change Order Limits and Administration Fees — Ridgeline Installation Services
content:
A change to the scope of a signed Ridgeline Installation Services contract is made by change order. Each program fixes the program change order administration fee for a signed change order that increases the price, the largest cumulative increase change orders may add before a new measure and quote are required, and how long a change order stays open for signature.

| Program | Program change order administration fee (USD) | Largest cumulative increase without a new measure and quote (percent of the contract price) | Change order open for signature (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Carpet Installation | 0.00 | 10 | 3 |
| Ridgeline Hard Surface Flooring Installation | 0.00 | 10 | 3 |
| Ridgeline Window and Door Installation | 25.00 | 10 | 5 |
| Ridgeline Kitchen Cabinet and Countertop Installation | 50.00 | 15 | 5 |
| Ridgeline Bath Remodel Installation | 50.00 | 15 | 5 |
| Ridgeline Roofing and Siding Installation | 50.00 | 10 | 5 |

## Notes

- The carpet and hard surface flooring programs carry no change order administration fee figure (0.00).
- The kitchen cabinet and countertop and bath remodel programs allow cumulative change order increases up to 15 percent of the contract price; every other program allows up to 10 percent.
- The signature period is counted in calendar days after the change order request was created.

## Hypothetical limit check

On a hypothetical Ridgeline Window and Door Installation contract of 4000.00, change orders may add up to 400.00 in total (10 percent) before a new measure and quote are required; on a Ridgeline Bath Remodel Installation contract of the same price the figure is 600.00 (15 percent).
